name: harness-core
description: The design harness core: the 5 evidence loops (insight → problem → ideation → wireframe → hifi-gate), their dependencies (design-tokens-sync, from-figma, art-direction, taste-retro, storybook-component), the 9-skill quality-gate suite (ship, verify-before-done, visual-qa, a11y-audit, performance-check, e2e-test, design-system-audit, review-ux, parallel-review), the design-system guard hooks, the project scaffold, and the qa + researcher agents.
